content.title: IEX Q3 Deep Dive: Organic Growth and Platform Integration Offset Cautious Guidance
content.summary: Manufacturing company IDEX (NYSE:IEX) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.1% year on year to $878.7 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $871.5 million was less impressive, coming in 2% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.03 per share was 5.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
